conditions.description: First run of usp_load_brnz_subs_invoice lands 5 synthetic Subs.tblSubsInvoices rows 1:1 into brnz_subs_invoice.
conditions.preconditions: Empty brnz_subs_invoice. Source holds rec_ids 1001-1005 covering GBP, EUR and HKD, every payment mode, a CRE credit note with negative amounts, a fully credited invoice and a full-concession invoice (Campaign Years 2022-2025). Assumes Q-037: audit columns are named _loaded_at, _updated_at, _is_deleted, _deleted_at as on the existing bronze tables.
conditions.expected: Exactly 5 rows, _is_deleted 0 on each. Every mapped column equals its source value, e.g. rec_id 1002: account_num 'A1002', campaign_year 2025, invoice 'INV-1002', voucher 'V1002', trans_date 2024-11-01, inv_payment_method 'Card', inv_currency 'EUR', exchange_rate 0.86, full/invoice amount cur 500.00, invoice_amount_gbp 430.00, credit 100.00 / 86.00, fully_credited 'N', payment_status 'Partially Paid', has_concession 'Y', full_concession_flag 'N'.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD002].[test TC-002-001 first invoice load lands 5 source rows 1:1 and live]

conditions.description: A source invoice with Inv_Payment_Method NULL lands with inv_payment_method NULL; bronze applies no default.
conditions.preconditions: Source rec_id 1101 with Inv_Payment_Method NULL and rec_id 1102 with 'DD'.
conditions.expected: rec_id 1101 has inv_payment_method NULL; rec_id 1102 is not NULL; both live (_is_deleted 0).
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD002].[test TC-002-002 null Inv_Payment_Method lands as null]

conditions.description: Blank and untrimmed lower-case payment modes land byte for byte: no null-to-blank, blank-to-null, trimming or case change in bronze.
conditions.preconditions: Source rec_id 1201 with Inv_Payment_Method N'' and rec_id 1202 with N' dd '.
conditions.expected: rec_id 1201 inv_payment_method is N'' (not NULL, 0 bytes); rec_id 1202 has the exact bytes of N' dd ' (leading and trailing space, lower case).
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD002].[test TC-002-003 blank and untrimmed payment methods land byte for byte]

conditions.description: The first invoice load records its outcome and counts in Layercake.etl_run_log via usp_etl_log_start / usp_etl_log_end.
conditions.preconditions: Empty brnz_subs_invoice and etl_run_log; 5 source rows (rec_ids 1301-1305).
conditions.expected: Exactly one etl_run_log row: status 'Success', rows_inserted 5, rows_updated 0, rows_deleted 0.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD002].[test TC-002-004 first invoice load logs Success with 5 rows inserted]

conditions.description: A second invoice load on unchanged source (including NULL columns) changes nothing and logs 0 inserted and 0 updated.
conditions.preconditions: 5 source rows (rec_ids 1401-1405, some with NULL payment mode and NULL payment status); load run twice.
conditions.expected: brnz_subs_invoice is identical (every column, including _loaded_at and _updated_at) before and after the second load; 5 live rows. etl_run_log holds two 'Success' rows: (5 inserted, 0 updated, 0 deleted) and (0, 0, 0).
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD002].[test TC-002-005 second invoice load on unchanged source changes nothing and logs 0 inserted 0 updated]

conditions.description: _loaded_at and _updated_at are set on every landed invoice row, including a row whose optional source columns are all NULL.
conditions.preconditions: Source rec_ids 1501 (fully populated) and 1502 (mostly NULL). Target faked with its defaults. Assumes Q-037: audit column names as on existing bronze tables.
conditions.expected: Both rows have non-NULL _loaded_at and _updated_at (values not asserted).
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD002].[test TC-002-006 every landed invoice row has _loaded_at and _updated_at]

conditions.description: A source row whose value changed is updated in place with _updated_at refreshed; an unchanged row is untouched; the update is counted.
conditions.preconditions: Bronze holds live rec_ids 2001 (payment_status 'Unpaid') and 2002 ('Paid'), both _loaded_at and _updated_at 2020-01-01. Source has 2001 now 'Paid' and 2002 unchanged.
conditions.expected: 2001: payment_status 'Paid', _loaded_at still 2020-01-01, _updated_at later than 2020-01-01. 2002: _updated_at still 2020-01-01. Both live. etl_run_log: 'Success', 0 inserted, 1 updated, 0 deleted.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD002].[test TC-002-007 changed source invoice row is updated and only it gets a new _updated_at]

conditions.description: An invoice row no longer in the source is soft-deleted, not physically removed.
conditions.preconditions: Bronze holds live rec_ids 3001 and 3002; source holds only 3001 (unchanged).
conditions.expected: 3001 stays live with _deleted_at NULL. 3002 is still present with payment_status 'Paid', _is_deleted 1 and _deleted_at set. etl_run_log: 'Success', 0 inserted, 0 updated, 1 deleted.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD002].[test TC-002-008 invoice row gone from source is soft deleted not removed]

conditions.description: A soft-deleted invoice row re-sent unchanged by the source is restored, not inserted a second time.
conditions.preconditions: Bronze holds rec_id 4001 with _is_deleted 1, _deleted_at 2020-06-01; source re-sends 4001 with identical values.
conditions.expected: Exactly one row for rec_id 4001: account_num 'A4001', payment_status 'Paid', _is_deleted 0.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD002].[test TC-002-009 soft deleted invoice row that reappears unchanged is restored]

conditions.description: The invoice load fails through the data: Invoice_Amount_CUR 1000000000000000000000000000.000000 (valid in the source's numeric(38,6)) overflows the design's invoice_amount_cur numeric(32,6). The error reaches the caller, the run is logged Failed and the target is unchanged.
conditions.preconditions: Bronze holds live rec_id 5001 with payment_status 'Unpaid'. Source has 5001 changed to 'Paid' and new rec_id 5002 with the overflowing amount. Relies on invoice_amount_cur being numeric(32,6) as DES-001 states. Run outside the tSQLt transaction.
conditions.expected: Arithmetic overflow error 8115 is raised to the caller. brnz_subs_invoice is identical to before (5001 still 'Unpaid', no 5002). etl_run_log holds one row with status 'Failed' and a non-NULL error_message.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD002].[test TC-002-010 invoice load failing on an overflowing amount re-raises logs Failed and leaves the target unchanged]

conditions.description: RULE-005 row-count check: after a load mixing inserts and a soft delete, live bronze rows equal the source row count and the counts are logged.
conditions.preconditions: Bronze holds live rec_ids 7001 and 7002. Source holds 7001 (unchanged), 7003 and 7004 (new).
conditions.expected: Rows 7001, 7003, 7004 live and 7002 soft-deleted (4 rows in total). Live count 3 equals the source count 3. etl_run_log: 'Success', 2 inserted, 0 updated, 1 deleted.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD002].[test TC-002-019 live invoice rows reconcile to the source row count after inserts and a soft delete]

conditions.description: First run of usp_load_brnz_subs_invoice_line lands 12 CUSTTRANS_RICS rows that meet RULE-077 1:1 into brnz_subs_invoice_line.
conditions.preconditions: Subs.tblSubsInvoices (and live brnz_subs_invoice) hold invoices A1/V1 and A2/V2. CUSTTRANS_RICS holds 12 in-scope rows: recids 101-104 and 107-110 are invoice lines (VOUCHER V1/V2 of all RICINVOICETYPEs, GBP and EUR); 105 and 111 are credits and 106 and 112 payments whose LASTSETTLEVOUCHER is V1/V2. Values use whole seconds (target transdate is datetime2(0)).
conditions.expected: Exactly 12 rows, _is_deleted 0. Every mapped column equals its source value, e.g. recid 112: accountnum 'A2', invoice NULL, voucher 'PAY2', lastsettlevoucher 'V2', transdate 2024-12-15 00:00:00, transtype 15, ricinvoicetype 'PAY', productcode NULL, amountcur -525.00, amountmst -451.50, settleamountcur -525.00, currencycode 'EUR', paymmode 'Card', paymreference 'CARDREF-112', ordernum NULL.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD002].[test TC-002-011 first line load lands 12 in-scope rows 1:1 and live]

conditions.description: The AC-002-06 scenario: only lines of a Subs.tblSubsInvoices voucher, and rows settling it, are landed.
conditions.preconditions: Subs.tblSubsInvoices holds voucher V1 for account A1. CUSTTRANS_RICS holds 3 rows A1/V1 (recids 201-203), 1 credit A1/CN1 with LASTSETTLEVOUCHER V1 (204) and 2 rows with VOUCHER V9 (205, 206), which is not in Subs.tblSubsInvoices.
conditions.expected: brnz_subs_invoice_line holds exactly 4 live rows: recids 201, 202, 203 and 204. No row for 205 or 206.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD002].[test TC-002-012 line load keeps the 3 V1 lines and the V1 credit and excludes the 2 V9 rows]

conditions.description: RULE-077 matches on ACCOUNTNUM and VOUCHER together: a line carrying the invoice's voucher under a different account is out of scope.
conditions.preconditions: Subs.tblSubsInvoices holds A1/V1. CUSTTRANS_RICS holds recid 301 (A1, V1) and recid 302 (A2, V1), neither with a LASTSETTLEVOUCHER.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD002].[test TC-002-013 line with the invoice voucher but another account is not landed]

conditions.description: A row that meets both RULE-077 conditions (VOUCHER V1 and LASTSETTLEVOUCHER V1) is landed once, not once per condition.
conditions.preconditions: Subs.tblSubsInvoices holds A1/V1. CUSTTRANS_RICS holds recid 401 (A1, VOUCHER V1, LASTSETTLEVOUCHER V1) and recid 402 (A1, VOUCHER V1).
conditions.expected: Exactly 2 rows: recid 401 once and recid 402 once, both live.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD002].[test TC-002-014 line matching on both voucher and last settle voucher lands once]

conditions.description: A landed line whose invoice has left Subs.tblSubsInvoices falls out of the RULE-077 scope and is soft-deleted, even though the CUSTTRANS_RICS row still exists.
conditions.preconditions: Subs.tblSubsInvoices holds only A1/V1 (A2/V2 gone; soft-deleted in brnz_subs_invoice). brnz_subs_invoice_line holds live recids 501 (A1/V1) and 502 (A2/V2); CUSTTRANS_RICS still holds both unchanged.
conditions.expected: 501 live with _deleted_at NULL; 502 present with _is_deleted 1 and _deleted_at set.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD002].[test TC-002-015 line whose invoice leaves Subs.tblSubsInvoices is soft deleted]

conditions.description: The line load logs like the invoice load, and a second run on unchanged source changes nothing.
conditions.preconditions: Subs.tblSubsInvoices holds A1/V1; CUSTTRANS_RICS holds 3 in-scope rows (601, 602, 603, the last with NULL productcode and ordernum). Load run twice.
conditions.expected: brnz_subs_invoice_line identical (every column) before and after the second load. etl_run_log holds two 'Success' rows: (3 inserted, 0 updated, 0 deleted) and (0, 0, 0).
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD002].[test TC-002-016 second line load on unchanged source changes nothing and both loads log Success]

conditions.description: _loaded_at and _updated_at are set on every landed line row, including a row whose optional source columns are NULL.
conditions.preconditions: Subs.tblSubsInvoices holds A1/V1; CUSTTRANS_RICS holds recid 701 (populated) and 702 (credit settling V1, mostly NULL). Target faked with its defaults. Assumes Q-037: audit column names as on existing bronze tables.
conditions.expected: Both rows have non-NULL _loaded_at and _updated_at (values not asserted).
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD002].[test TC-002-017 every landed line row has _loaded_at and _updated_at]

conditions.description: The line load fails through the data: an ORDERNUM of 29 characters (valid in the source's nvarchar(50)) does not fit the design's ordernum nvarchar(20). The error reaches the caller, the run is logged Failed and the target is unchanged.
conditions.preconditions: Subs.tblSubsInvoices holds A1/V1. brnz_subs_invoice_line holds live recid 801 with amountcur 400.00. CUSTTRANS_RICS has 801 changed to 450.00 and new recid 802 with ORDERNUM 'ORD-0000000000000000000000001'. Relies on ordernum being nvarchar(20) as DES-001 states. Run outside the tSQLt transaction.
conditions.expected: A string truncation error (2628 or 8152) is raised to the caller. brnz_subs_invoice_line is identical to before (801 still 400.00, no 802). etl_run_log holds one row with status 'Failed' and a non-NULL error_message.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD002].[test TC-002-018 line load failing on an over-long ORDERNUM re-raises logs Failed and leaves the target unchanged]
